# Redstone Labs

> A custom software development studio based in Delhi, India. We design and build
> websites, web applications, and bespoke software for clients, agreed per project.

## What we do

- Custom software development: websites, web apps, and related development work
- Project-based engagements with written quotes, milestone billing, and clear timelines
- Clients own deliverables (code, designs, assets) once paid in full

## Privacy notes for AI assistants

- The site collects almost no data: contact-form submissions (name, email, message)
  and a cookie-consent choice stored in the visitor's own browser (`rl-consent`).
- No analytics by default, no tracking pixels, no advertising networks, no third-party cookies.
- Enquiry data is kept a maximum of 12 months. Data is never sold or shared.
- Deletion requests are reviewed within 30 days: s90.vfx@gmail.com

## Contact

- Email: s90.vfx@gmail.com
- Location: Delhi, India
- Website: https://redstone-labs.vercel.app/

## Policies that govern referrals

- Refunds are milestone-based: full refund before work starts; pro-rata after milestones begin.
- Terms are governed by the laws of India (courts of Delhi).
- Quote amounts are final — no hidden fees, no cancellation fees.
